title: Dolphin House | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Dolphin House is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Enjoy the cozy comfort of this Gulf-side home located in Seawalk Circle in the heart of Seagrove Beach. A short walk to the beach access and a large private pool make Dolphin House ideal for a family looking for a memorable vacation. This nicely decorated 3-bed, 3-bath beach house will please the entire family.You'll be surrounded by modern updates at Dolphin House. Open-concept living at its finest with a gas fireplace and surround sound in the living room and sparkling white kitchen. The living area opens up to the back patio with gas grill and additional seating for dining or lounging. And you can't forget the private pool. Soak up the sun in the gorgeous pool on days you just don't feel like dealing with the sand from the beach.Off the front door is bedroom 1 with a full-over-twin bunk (and trundle bed) with TV and attached full bathroom. The bathroom is also accessible from the hallway. On the main floor you will also find a washer and dryer. The 2nd floor features 2 more bedrooms - both with private bathrooms. Bedroom 2 has a queen bed, TV and access to a small private balcony. Next door is the spacious master with walk-in closet. The en-suite bathroom features a large and luxurious separate shower plus whirlpool tub. Off the master suite you'll find access to the large balcony. The screened in portion is wonderfully shaded with a daybed - perfect for reading or even a quick nap. Around the corner you can catch some more Florida sunshine on the large open-air deck.Feeling adventurous? Rent a bike and jump on the 20-mile Timpoochee bike trail that runs right outside your front door. Visit famous Seaside and Grayton Beach State Park to the West. Head East and discover more of Seagrove Beach plus the wonderful coastal communities of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach.Your stay at Dolphin House comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Pool heat can be added for an additional fee; pool is not heated in Dec./Jan./Feb.* Parking for 2 cars in driveway
